description: AGSC-09-93 with AGSC-10-04: the derived ledger is part of Level 2, so a discovery document checked at Level 2 whose node is not restricted MUST carry the `https://w3id.org/agentic-system-core/rel#ledger` link, and a validator reports its absence as AGSC-E202. Derivation, case by case. (1) A public Level-2 document with the ledger link (its `digest` and `agsc-ledger-head` present, AGSC-06-08) is valid. (2) The same document without the ledger link is invalid with exactly one error, AGSC-E202: every other attribute AGSC-06-08a requires is still present, so the missing link is the only fault. (3) A restricted node (AGSC-11-20) publishes no ledger link and no `agsc-ledger-head`, and its document is valid at Level 2 without them, because its unauthenticated view is what it asserts conformance for.
